title: Right Answers, Inconsistent Evidence: Source-Level Counterfactual Auditing of Large Audio-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.15463v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A large audio-language model (LALM) can answer "is a cat present?" about a mixture correctly, and its confidence can drop when the cat is removed, yet this does not show that it can tell the cat's presence from its absence. We introduce TRACE. It deletes the queried source and each rival in turn and asks whether every view still containing that sound outscores the view with it removed. Across 8 LALMs and 3,456 controlled mixtures, 6.3% of correct answers fail this ordering: the target-absent view scores at or above some target-present view, a conflict no shared threshold repairs. A target-only score check misses 42.5% of them. The share rises from 4.9% to 8.4% as target SNR falls from +5 to -5 dB, even on units correct at every level, and survives loudness and re-pairing controls. Accuracy certifies the answer; TRACE audits whether it orders presence above absence. Code and data: https://github.com/yikise/TRACE.

translated_title: 正确的答案，不一致的证据：大型音频-语言模型的源级反事实审计
translated_abstract: 大型音频-语言模型能够正确回答关于混合音频中“是否有猫？”的问题，且当猫被移除时其置信度会下降，但这并不能表明它真正能够区分目标声源的存在与缺失。我们提出了TRACE方法：它依次删除被查询的声源和每个竞争声源，并检验每一个仍包含该声音的视图得分是否都高于删除该声音后的视图。在8个大型音频-语言模型和3,456个受控混合音频上，6.3%的正确答案未能通过这种排序检验：目标缺失的视图得分等于或高于某个目标存在的视图，这种冲突无法通过任何共享阈值修复。仅检查目标分数会遗漏其中42.5%的情况。随着目标信噪比从+5 dB降至-5 dB，这一比例从4.9%升至8.4%，即使是在所有信噪比水平上都回答正确的单元上也存在，并且在响度和重新配对控制下依然成立。准确率只能证明答案本身；TRACE则审计模型是否将“存在”排序在“缺失”之上。代码和数据见：https://github.com/yikise/TRACE。
tldr: 该论文提出TRACE源级反事实审计方法，通过逐一删除声源并检验排序一致性，发现大型音频-语言模型中6.3%的正确答案存在“存在与缺失”排序不一致的问题，且该问题随信噪比降低而加剧、无法用共享阈值修复。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces TRACE, a source-level counterfactual auditing method that reveals 6.3% of correct answers from large audio-language models fail presence-over-absence ordering consistency, a conflict unfixable by shared thresholds and worsened by lower target SNRs.
